reason: The closure facade every agent runs on its own changed set before a ticket transition; it is the agent-closure runner by definition.

The static-gates workflow runs assert-fast-gates.ps1 on every push to main and DEBUG-v* and every pull request to main, which is what makes the class per-change; the operator-typed fg batch runs the same set and never satisfies it alone. The batch reads the whole tracked tree, so the workflow carries no path filter. PLAN/ and .claude/ are gitignored and never reach CI; their gates answer NOT RUN there (lib/absent-input.ps1).
Run once per release at /spec-prerelease step 0.4; its subject is the whole tree at the release boundary.
Run by /spec-prerelease and /spec-prerelease-wear before a release ships; release-bound content.
Invoked by the release build and the scripts/builders entry points; it judges a built artifact.
Wired into no scanned runner; an operator or a command driver invokes it by name.
A stage is invoked directly by another gate and runs wherever that gate runs; its contract class is the parent's.
An aggregator that runs other gates; it checks nothing, so it holds no contract class of its own.
